set.body: The parity-gated side-256 directional comparison measured Ravel copy_inner_stride at 0.017x and copy_transpose at 0.065x NumPy speed. Replace callback-based public copy traversal with dtype-specialized contiguous-output kernels for linear, inner-strided, and general layouts. Acceptance: differential laws for adversarial views, allocation proof, JMH GC profile, and repeated same-host NumPy comparison without changing ownership semantics.
set.title: Specialize strided and transposed copy kernels
